definitions.explanation: The standard of something when compared to other things.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{質|しつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|い}い→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This product is of good quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{質|しつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Quality is more important than quantity.
The price is cheap, but the quality is poor, so you shouldn't buy it.

notes:
{質|しつ} refers to quality, nature, or character of something.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {質|しつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|い}い→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: good/high quality
- {質|しつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: poor/low quality
- {質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to improve quality
- {質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain quality

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧: product quality
- ⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧: nature, character
- ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: constitution, physique
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: question

- ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{質|しつ}: quality over quantity
